plan.title: Award service activities to two vendors

steps.note: Open the existing closed service RFQ with bids from Vendors A and B.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Enter the awarding screen for the closed event.
Verify both activities and both vendors are selected for the award.
Create the proposal from the completed activity-wise allocation.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted.
Complete the award approval flow and create one purchase order per awarded vendor.
Verify the purchase orders contain the two awarded activities.
